research_question: When B2-v2's internal stages (R1 proposition-analysis, R2 role/support audit) disagree, or when R1 fails to decompose a proposition at all, which reading of the sentence/source boundary do independent, non-technical humans find more plausible? This round samples 4 distinct known failure/uncertainty shapes plus 1 agreement control — it does not resolve B2's own correctness, and no response here automatically changes any prompt, model, or threshold.
dataset_purpose_note: Development material only -- NOT blind_calibration, NOT held_out_evaluation, NOT cross-publisher evaluation. All 5 items are drawn from cj2-fresh-batch-1 (H05/H08/H14/H17) and cj2-reference-probe-1 (05_dutch_painting_soldier/Z), already-inspected B2-v2 regression fixtures -- never untouched cross-publisher held-out corpus.
